# Differential cases for the entity allocation, kind and subkind chains,
# codes and names of G3's olympia/code.c (and if_name() in olympia/io.c), at
# G3 47535543d83fbc5649d54b63b49e578f2b11ab1c.
#
# tools/code-compat/run.sh feeds this file to a C driver built from the
# pinned sources and records its output in code-c-output.txt;
# TestCodeMatchesC feeds it to the Go port and requires the same output.
#
# Each "section NAME" line starts a section. Every section runs in a fresh
# process (a fresh world, after glob_init()), so a section may end in a
# failed assertion: the driver prints what asfail() prints and the process
# aborts, and run.sh adds "exit STATUS" after each section. stderr goes to
# the same place as stdout, in order.
#
# One operation per line; a line that starts with '#' is a comment, and
# blank lines are skipped. N, K, SK and L are integers, read with
# strtol(s, NULL, 0). TEXT is the rest of the line after one space, with
# \xHH and \\ escapes; with no space it is empty.
#
#   alloc N K SK      alloc_box(N, K, SK)
#   delete N          delete_box(N)
#   kind N K          change_box_kind(N, K)
#   sub N SK          change_box_subkind(N, SK)
#   chains            every non-empty kind and subkind chain, from
#                     kind_first/kind_next and sub_first/sub_next
#   loop kind K [del | add N K2 SK2]
#   loop sub SK [del | add N K2 SK2]
#                     loop_kind / loop_subkind, printing each box; "del"
#                     deletes each box the loop visits, "add" allocates box
#                     N on the first visit
#   loop boxes        loop_boxes
#   loop locship      loop_loc_or_ship
#   usage             print_box_usage()
#   name N            name(N)
#   setname N TEXT    set_name(N, TEXT)
#   banner N TEXT     set_banner(N, TEXT), then the banner (or NULL)
#   ifname N P        if_name(N) with pretty_data_files = P
#   loc N             loc(N)
#   boxcode N         box_code(N) and box_code_less(N)
#   code L            int_to_code(L), and code_to_int() of the result
#   int TEXT          code_to_int(TEXT)
#   scode TEXT        scode(TEXT)
#   letter TEXT       letter_val(c, letters2) for each byte c of TEXT
#   codesum           checksums over the whole code space (see the driver)
